official.application_cycle: Annual cycle announced on the programme page; the arts-plastics line opens in the second half of 2026 and the economic-law line is offered from the second half of 2026
official.status_note: The programme page announces its patronage lines by discipline and states the arts and economic-law lines open in the second half of 2026; the exact closing date is published per call news item and could not be re-read during verification.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The programme is a sponsorship of the overseas postgraduate programme at the sponsoring institution; the page does not state a stipend, living allowance or travel benefit in the read text.
benefits: Sponsorship of an overseas postgraduate programme at a foreign university of recognised academic excellence
Up to five doctoral places in economics
Master's places in public administration and public policy
One place for economic law (master's or doctorate)
Young-talent patronage in plastic arts and in music
eligibility: Admission to, or application for, a postgraduate programme at a foreign university of recognised academic excellence
Arts line: plastic-arts professionals seeking study in painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, photography, performance, installations, new digital media and audiovisual technology
Music line: professionals who demonstrate artistic merits and qualities
Economic-law line: a law professional seeking a master's or doctorate in economic law
Economics line: five places for a doctorate in economics and/or master's degrees in public administration or public policy
requirements: Study at a university on the line's published reference list
Create an account on the Banco de la República postgraduate sponsorship platform
Complete and submit the sponsorship application electronically
documents: Follow the 'Instructivo de postulación para patrocinio de estudios en el exterior' published by the bank
selection_criteria: Merit and excellence of the candidate for the sponsored study
Match of the candidate and programme with the line's reference lists
For the arts lines: creative processes and demonstrated artistic merit
coverage: Postgraduate study sponsorship at the foreign institution for the sponsored programme years
Doctoral sponsorship up to a maximum of the fourth year of the overseas programme
application_method: Step 1: create an account on the 'Patrocinio posgrados' platform
Step 3: submit the application and track it on the platform
official.application_route: Create an account on the bank's 'Patrocinio posgrados' platform, complete the application and submit it electronically.
official.citizenship_residency: Colombian applicants (the patronage lines are published for Colombian professionals)
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Discipline lines: economics (doctorate; master's in public administration and public policy), economic law (master's or doctorate), plastic arts (painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, photography, performance, installations, new digital media and audiovisual technology) and music
official.duration: Doctoral sponsorship up to a maximum of the fourth year of the programme; the economic-law patronage covers a master's or doctorate up to the second or fourth year according to the programme
official.description: The Banco de la República sponsors postgraduate study at foreign institutions of recognised academic excellence for Colombian professionals, organised by discipline lines: doctoral study in economics, master's degrees in public administration and public policy, a postgraduate qualification in economic law, and young-talent patronage in plastic arts and in music.

verification.notes: During this verification session the Banco de la República site (www.banrep.gov.co) repeatedly returned a Radware bot-manager captcha (five attempts, including a real browser), so the programme page could not be re-read on 2026-10-10. The official block carries only the wording previously extracted from this official page by the catalogue build; no amount, deadline or benefit figure was confirmed or invented here. Applicants must re-read the bank's own programme page and the 'Instructivo de postulación' before relying on any detail.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a discipline-by-discipline patronage, not an open competition: first work out which of the bank's lines (economics, public administration/public policy, economic law, plastic arts, music) you belong to, because each line has its own reference list of foreign universities and its own call. Your target university must appear on that line's current list - the lists are published per cycle and older versions circulate, so confirm the current one with the bank. Because the cycle is announced by news item on the programme page, check the page itself rather than any aggregator.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Colombian professionals in economics, public administration/public policy, economic law, plastic arts or music who hold or are securing a place at a reference-listed foreign university.
application_readiness_checklist: Identify your exact line and obtain its current reference list of universities and programmes from the bank
Create the account on the 'Patrocinio posgrados' platform before the call opens, since the application is electronic
Download and follow the bank's 'Instructivo de postulación' for the document set
For arts and music lines, prepare evidence of artistic merit - exhibitions, repertoire, commissions - rather than only academic records
If in economic law or economics, align your programme choice with the listed universities before applying
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a university that is not on the line's current reference list
Applying to the wrong line for the discipline or degree level
Missing the call because the cycle opens by news item on the programme page rather than a fixed annual date
Submitting an incomplete electronic application through the platform before the closing moment
Relying on outdated reference lists from earlier cycles
document_audit: The instructivo, not any third-party summary, defines the application file - always check the bank's own document
Arts and music lines assess merit portfolios differently from academic lines; the same CV format will not work for both
For economics/law lines the degree to be sponsored must match the line exactly (doctorate vs master's)
alerts: The programme page was bot-blocked during verification - re-check it directly for the current cycle dates before planning around any date here
Each line opens separately (arts-plastics and economic law in the second half of 2026 per the page), so a missed line may mean waiting a full cycle
Reference lists have shown older cycle dates in places; confirm the current list with the bank
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the bank's sponsorship platform, complete the application for your line and submit electronically, tracking the file on the platform; selection and any interviews are run by the bank per line.
